title: Research: complete Boolean paid inventory for Norm∘F_(2,1) (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers open question 1 of merged [#2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950) (`weighted-wrapper-contract`): can a proposed weighted callee be normalized at an affordable **complete** cost?

On the unchanged PR2808 Boolean origin-plane fixture (`M=3`, `n=2`, `a=(2,1)`, volume **81**, **7** planes) the raw weighted callee attains only **9/81** agreements with interchange `J`. Post-composing each `F_a` call by the two output scales that realize `F_{P'}` for `P'=T P`, `T=diag(1,2)`, the ordinary wrapper attains **81/81**. The paid inventory meters every OQ1 line item on that fixture:

| Line item | Count |
|---|---:|
| scale | **2268** |
| inverse | **2268** |
| source_access | **1134** |
| restoration | **1162** |
| frame_copy (pad_in + pad_out + callee) | **3402** |

Wrong-scale controls stay imperfect. **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

Supersedes a deferred algebraic scale-only bill (`scales_two_F=4V=36`) that omitted inverse/source-access/restoration/frame/copy and was not Boolean-bound. Does not claim a supplier saving or selected GL64 admission.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice/`
- Tip: `39a10c77654c429d79d3944bfbf244766538bdbd`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — complete Boolean-bound paid inventory answering #2950 OQ1

Closest prior: [#2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950); PR2808 ordinary wrapper / Boolean fixture. Soft overlap vs deferred scale-only package is intentional semantic completion (verify≈0.5, new `invoice.py`), not a ~0.9 scaffold retarget of a closed claim.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_WEIGHTED_CALLEE_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE M=3 n=2 a=(2,1) raw_agreements=9/81 normalized_agreements=81/81 scale=2268 inverse=2268 source_access=1134 restoration=1162 frame_copy=3402 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WEIGHTED_CALLEE_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE raw=9/81 normalized=81/81 scale=2268 inverse=2268 source_access=1134 restoration=1162 frame_copy=3402 no_new_kappa
PASS_WEIGHTED_CALLEE_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/weighted-callee-boolean-norm-invoice outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Does the same Norm∘F_a Boolean inventory remain complete for the precision-blind family `a=(1+p^{w-1},1)` on `(Z/p^w Z)^2` without enlarging the scale support? First re-run the harness at `p=3,w=2` with `a=(4,1)`.
